policy.rule: A tool may only be used by the pipeline if confidence=verified and status=current. Anything else must be marked experimental in code and in docs.

corrections.claim: "Nano Banana has a free API tier"
corrections.reality: False as of 2026-10-26. Google's pricing rows show no free tier for image OUTPUT on gemini-nano-banana-2.1, gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image or gemini-3-pro-image. Free access exists only in consumer surfaces (Gemini app, AI Mode 25 images/24h, Flow 50 credits/day), which are not automatable.

corrections.claim: "Kling and Hailuo have free daily tiers you can automate"
corrections.reality: False. Kling's free tier is 66 credits/day on the web app only (no API), watermarked, explicitly non-commercial, single queue. Hailuo replaced recurring daily credits with a one-time welcome grant that expires in ~3 days; its API 'free tier' is a rate limit (5 req/min legacy, 2 concurrent H3), not free clips.

corrections.claim: "FramePack is the state of the art for long video"
corrections.reality: It is still the cheapest path to 120 s single takes on 6 GB, but the upstream repo is effectively unmaintained (public discussion: 'project has been abandoned'). Treat it as a legacy option, not the default.

It broke on 2026-10-12: Microsoft rotated the Sec-MS-GEC token and every release before 7.3.0 returns HTTP 403 on all requests. 7.3.0/7.3.1 (2026-10-13) fixed the handshake. It also 403s from GitHub-hosted runners, so it is not a CI engine.

No. HunyuanVideo 1.5 is under a Tencent community licence that explicitly does not apply in the EU, UK or South Korea. LTX-2.x is free only below $10M annual revenue. F5-TTS weights are CC-BY-NC, Fish Audio S2 is research-only, n8n is source-available (Sustainable Use License) not open source. Licence is a first-class field in this registry.

tools.name: Nano Banana 2.1 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image successor)
tools.notes: GA 2026-10-06. Up to 14 reference images -> this is the identity-lock workhorse. SynthID watermark on every output. Consumer app access is free but not scriptable.

tools.name: Nano Banana 2
tools.notes: Shutdown 2026-10-29. The pipeline refuses to start new work on it (keyframes.py hard guard).

tools.name: Nano Banana Pro
tools.notes: Highest fidelity text rendering and brand consistency. Use only for hero shots: 4x the price of 2.1.

tools.name: FLUX.1 (local)
tools.notes: Offline fallback when no API budget exists. Weaker identity retention than Nano Banana references; needs IP-Adapter/InstantID for faces. Licence differs per checkpoint -- check before shipping.

tools.name: Wan 2.2 FLF2V / I2V-A14B
tools.model_id: wan2.2-i2v-a14b (FLF2V via ComfyUI Wan22 14B FLF2V template)
tools.cost: $0.00 (own GPU) / ~$0.30-0.60 per clip on rented A100
tools.notes: First-last-frame-to-video: seams are solved by construction. 81 frames @ 16 fps default for 14B. MoE: 27B total, 14B active.

tools.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B
tools.notes: 121 frames @ 24 fps. The variant that fits a free Kaggle T4 / 8 GB laptop. One 16x16x4 VAE covers text- and image-to-video.

tools.name: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
tools.free_tier: None (paid API). Consumer surfaces: YouTube Shorts Remix, Google AI plans
tools.notes: GA 2026-08-27. 3-10 s clips, extensions to ~40 s, 24 fps, 360p-4K, native synchronised audio, first/last-frame control. Preview id gemini-omni-flash-preview retired 2026-09-30. Wire format unverified in this repo -> probe-gated engine.

tools.name: LTX-2.5
tools.free_tier: Free to self-host below $10M annual revenue
tools.commercial_use: Yes below revenue ceiling; paid licence above
tools.notes: Released 2026-08-11. Up to 4K/50 fps WITH synchronised audio in one pass -- the only open-weight family here that gives you sound for free. Not Apache: enterprise must read the ceiling.

tools.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
tools.commercial_use: Yes below 100M MAU -- BUT licence does not apply in EU / UK / South Korea
tools.notes: 8.3B, 1080p via super-resolution, ~75 s per render on a 4090 with the step-distilled checkpoint. Jurisdiction restriction is disqualifying for many teams -- hence not the default.

tools.name: FramePack
tools.notes: 60-120 s single takes at 30 fps on 6 GB via constant-size frame context. Upstream is effectively unmaintained; use the ComfyUI wrapper (kijai) and pin your model files. Not the default.

tools.name: Kling 3.0 (free web tier)
tools.notes: No API on the free plan and no commercial rights: cannot be legally automated into a production pipeline. Listed for human previz only.

tools.name: Hailuo / MiniMax H3 (free tier)
tools.free_tier: One-time welcome credits expiring in ~3 days (daily credits removed)
tools.notes: API 'free tier' is a rate limit (5 req/min legacy Hailuo, 2 concurrent H3), not free clips. 6 s @ 768p, watermarked.

tools.name: Kokoro-82M
tools.hardware: CPU or ~2-3 GB VRAM; ~90 MB quantised
tools.notes: 54 voices, 8 languages, ~1060 Elo, no voice cloning. Apache-2.0 is why it is the default: the entire pipeline stays commercially shippable.

tools.name: Chatterbox / Chatterbox Turbo
tools.notes: The permissive-licence option when you need zero-shot cloning (~5-10 s reference). MIT code AND weights -- unlike F5-TTS.

tools.name: edge-tts
tools.free_tier: Free (unofficial use of the Edge read-aloud service)
tools.commercial_use: Unclear -- service, not a licence grant
tools.notes: MUST be >= 7.3.1: Microsoft rotated Sec-MS-GEC on 2026-10-12 and every earlier release 403s. Also 403s from GitHub-hosted runners. Never the CI default; never for a client deliverable without review.

tools.name: F5-TTS
tools.notes: Excellent cloning, but the weights licence forbids commercial use. Excluded from the default pipeline for that reason alone.

tools.name: Fish Audio S2 Pro
tools.notes: Top of several 2026 blind-test leaderboards (1116 Elo) and 80+ languages -- but the 'now open-source' marketing conflicts with the actual weights licence. Read it before you ship.

tools.name: WhisperX
tools.notes: Pin >=3.8.4: 3.8.2 and 3.8.3 were yanked (missing word timestamps for digits/symbols). Alignment is a separate wav2vec2 stage -- ASR timestamps alone drift hundreds of ms.

tools.name: faster-whisper
tools.notes: Still the engine inside WhisperX. Upstream is quiet (last release 1.2.1, Oct 2025) but the CTranslate2 runtime underneath is active. Word timestamps are approximate (+/-100-500 ms) -- align, don't trust.

tools.name: ComfyUI
tools.commercial_use: Yes (GPL: obligations attach if you distribute)
tools.notes: Ships Wan 2.2 14B FLF2V and 5B templates. Our graphs are tokenised API exports; validate node classes against /object_info before rendering (scripts/validate_comfy.py).

tools.name: FFmpeg
tools.license_id: LGPL-2.1+ (or GPL-2.0+ depending on build flags)
tools.notes: Verified in this repo against 7.0.2 static: libass, loudnorm, sidechaincompress, tpad, freezedetect all present. Needs libass to burn ASS.

tools.name: n8n (self-hosted Community)
tools.license_id: Sustainable Use License (source-available, NOT OSI open source)
tools.free_tier: Free self-hosted, unlimited executions, no node cap
tools.commercial_use: Yes for internal use / client work where only you edit workflows; a commercial licence is required if outsiders build workflows through your instance
tools.notes: n8n 3.0 (Oct 2026) is Docker-only and removes the Function/Cron nodes -> our workflows use Code + Schedule Trigger. Git version control is an Enterprise feature.

tools.name: GitHub Actions
tools.free_tier: Unlimited for public repos; 2000 min/month private
tools.notes: Perfect for assembly, registry refresh and cron. Not for diffusion. Artifacts expire (90 days default) -- keep state in the DB + artifact, not in git.
